Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 141. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 30 ki
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 100 feet (15 foot radius sphere)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Blast
Create a blue orb of energy in front of you before
launching it to explode at your target.
Choose a location within 100 feet, and all creatures in
a 15 foot radius must make a dexterity saving throw or
take 8d8 fire damage, half on a success.
